meta.title: 示例批次 · 外贸物流核心词汇
meta.source: 内置示例（可直接导入测试）

words.definition: 船公司签发的货物收据、运输合同证明和物权凭证。
words.exampleEn: Please release the cargo against the original Bill of Lading.

words.definition: 银行应买方申请开立、承诺凭符合条款的单据付款的结算方式。
words.exampleEn: Payment will be made by an irrevocable Letter of Credit at sight.
words.exampleZh: 付款方式为不可撤销即期信用证。

words.translation: 装运港船上交货（离岸价）
words.definition: 卖方负责将货物装上买方指定船只，风险自货物装上船起转移给买方。
words.exampleEn: We quote FOB Shanghai at USD 12.50 per piece.
words.exampleZh: 我方报上海离岸价每件12.50美元。

words.translation: 成本加保险费加运费（到岸价）
words.definition: 卖方承担成本、保险费与运费至目的港，风险仍在装运港转移。
words.exampleEn: The offer is CIF Rotterdam, with insurance covering 110% of the invoice value.
words.exampleZh: 此报价为鹿特丹到岸价，按发票金额110%投保。

words.definition: 进出口货物向海关申报、缴税并获放行的手续。
words.exampleEn: It usually takes two working days for customs clearance at Ningbo Port.
words.exampleZh: 宁波港清关通常需要两个工作日。

words.definition: 未在免堆期/免箱期内完成作业而产生的费用。
words.exampleEn: Demurrage will be charged if the container is not returned within the free time.
words.exampleZh: 如未在免箱期内还箱将产生滞箱费。

words.definition: 集装箱运量的计量单位（Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit）。
words.exampleEn: This vessel has a capacity of 14,000 TEUs.

words.definition: 买方向卖方询问价格与交易条件的函电。
words.exampleEn: Thank you for your inquiry dated October 10 regarding our ceramic mugs.
words.exampleZh: 感谢您10月10日关于我方陶瓷杯的询盘。

words.definition: 卖方对特定数量商品开列的价格与交易条件。
words.exampleEn: Please find our latest quotation, valid for 30 days.
words.exampleZh: 请查收我方最新报价单，有效期30天。

words.definition: 将货物装上运输工具的过程，也指所装运的一批货物。
words.exampleEn: The shipment is scheduled to depart on October 20.
words.exampleZh: 该批货物定于10月20日装运出港。

words.definition: 替委托人安排运输、订舱、报关等事宜的中介机构。
words.exampleEn: Please contact our freight forwarder for the warehouse address.
words.exampleZh: 请联系我方货代获取仓库地址。

words.definition: 证明货物原产地的文件，用于享受关税优惠。
words.exampleEn: A Certificate of Origin is required for tariff preference.
words.exampleZh: 享受关税优惠需提供原产地证书。

sentences.en: Could you please send us your best price for 5,000 pieces, FOB Ningbo?
sentences.zh: 请报5,000件的最优价格，FOB宁波条件。
sentences.notes: best price 最优价；counter-offer 还盘

sentences.en: This price is valid for 30 days and subject to our final confirmation.
sentences.zh: 本报价有效期30天，以我方最终确认为准。

sentences.en: The earliest shipment date is November 15, as vessel space is quite tight recently.
sentences.zh: 由于近期舱位紧张，最早装运期为11月15日。

sentences.en: We accept payment by irrevocable L/C payable against presentation of shipping documents.
sentences.zh: 我们接受凭装运单据付款的不可撤销信用证。

sentences.en: Upon survey, 15% of the cartons were found badly damaged, and we hereby lodge a claim.
sentences.zh: 经检验，15%的纸箱严重破损，我方特此提出索赔。
sentences.notes: lodge a claim 提出索赔

sentences.en: Please advise the ETD and ETA of the vessel so that we can arrange customs clearance in advance.
sentences.zh: 请告知船舶预计离港和到港时间，以便我们提前安排清关。
sentences.notes: ETD 预计离港时间 / ETA 预计到港时间
